notes.title: Chapter 27/Epilogue 2 Dev Update
notes.content:
Happy April everyone! Hope you're doing well. I have a few things I want to cover here, so let's get started!

Based on your feedback, I'll begin working on learning Blender and getting things going for Game 2, so that there's less of a downtime between the completion of the epilogues and the first releases of Game 2. I'll also begin releasing information about the new game over time as I finalize things. There'll be a few more polls for your feedback in the future, but nothing immediately; right now, I'm focusing on foundational/fundamental stuff for the new game.

Now, here are the game updates!

PoP - Work on Epilogue 2 is slightly ahead of schedule, so we should definitely have a release in mid-May. I've swapped the order of the epilogues slightly, so the second epilogue will be about a fun project you and Legacy work on together. It's definitely more on the fun end of things compared to the previous one, and I think it'll be really enjoyable to see the characters in a more casual/relaxed setting vs. saving the world.

Game 2 - There will be two cute elf LIs, one of whom will be redheaded. If you like cute elf girls, this will absolutely be a game for you. If not... You should change your preferences to include liking cute elf girls. :)

If you have any questions or want to chat, you can always join the Discord or comment here! Thanks for reading! :)

notes.title: Price of Power Release!
notes.content:
Happy Valentine's Day everyone! Price of Power has been a labor of love for over four years, and I'm very happy and proud to say that the game is finally ready for a full release! The main plot is complete, I've done some cleanup work on earlier renders, fixed up some bugs and typos, and added in requested features like a scene gallery and an SFW mode. With all this work finally done, the game is now leaving Early Access! The current price will only last for a couple weeks, at which point it'll be increasing to $19.99 USD as 
I said earlier. Grab it now while you can!

Also as promised earlier, this isn't the end of Price of Power - there's still more to come. I'll be working on the five epilogue chapters now to keep expanding the story, and they'll all be available for free as part of the game. You can see my earlier development updates for details on what I've been planning, as well as leave me ideas for things you might want to see!

Thank you all for your support over the last few years; I couldn't have done this without you. I hope you've enjoyed the game and will enjoy the epilogues coming up in the next few months. :)

Changelog:
[list]
[*] Updated early game images to fix issues
[*] Added end of game scene gallery
[*] Added SFW mode
[*] Typo corrections
[/list]

PS - keep an eye out for a surprise I've been working on for a little while, coming soon...

notes.title: Chapter 14 Hotfix
notes.content:
Hello everyone! I've done a lot more testing and the achievement bug that shipped with Chapter 14 should now be fixed. There's a fairly small patch (7-8MB) that should make everything work again. Once the patch is installed, you'll just need to load your most recent autosave and the achievements [b]should[/b] be granted. You won't need to replay any portion of the game, just load the autosave and get those achievements! If this bugfix doesn't work for you, please let me know in the comments, but it's worked for everyone who's tested it so far.

Thank you for your patience and have a great New Year!

notes.title: Quick Status Update on the Upcoming Release
notes.content: Hello everyone - happy New Year's! Just a quick update that the game will be released on January 21st as previously announced! I've finished work on the content that will be released (Chapters 1-8), so all that's left is to polish it up nicely and implement Steam achievement support. I really want to make sure that the Steam achievements are there from day 1, so that's one of my big goals between now and then. I can't wait for you all to play and enjoy the game - we're almost there! Have a great New Year!
